+    """Return the lexicographically sorted connected components of rows."""
+    neighbors = {}
+    for left, right in rows:
+        neighbors.setdefault(left, set()).add(right)
+        neighbors.setdefault(right, set()).add(left)
+
+    components = []
+    unseen = set(neighbors)
+    while unseen:
+        start = min(unseen)
+        stack = [start]
+        unseen.remove(start)
+        component = []
